Name: Milka cows and chocolate milk
Author: namesrstoopid
Description:
This is my first mod so I wanted something quick and simple to learn the basics of modding.

The mod adds a purple Milka cow as a variant of the normal cow, so instead of a brown or white cow you might get one of these when you buy a cow at Marnie's ranch. It produces chocolate milk, which some characters will love (especially the kids) and some won't. 

If there's interest, I could add some kind of recipe for making the chocolate milk into chocolate, either in a machine or in the kitchen. If you have suggestions for that or anything else that would fit the mod, don't hesitate to tell me. No promises I'll end up doing it, but I'm fully open to suggestions.

Disclaimer: I will not opt this mod in for any donations or rewards so please, if anyone from the Milka company sees this, know I will not be making a cent off of this, see it as a free ad and do not sue me into oblivion. Thanks <3
